---
name: Finding
about: Record something observed or inferred, with a way to reproduce it
labels: type:finding
---

## Statement

One or two sentences. Say plainly what is true.

## Observed or inferred

Mark each part. If any of it is inference, say what would confirm it.

## Evidence

Addresses, run names, or counts. No firmware bytes, dumps, hex or base64 of
real data, and no raw logs or screenshots.

## How to reproduce

The command or script, and the simulator state it needs.

## Confidence and limits

High, medium or low, and what this does not show.

## Lane

Which lane owns the follow-up: claude, codex or shared.
